raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was partly re-delivered: its ingest_ts range runs to 2026-01-17 22:00, not only 02:00. The replayed rows repeat existing txn_ids, so silver_transactions has duplicate keys and the gold tables double-count them. The txn_id range 900001-904866 is fully populated with no gaps, so deduplicating by txn_id, keeping the latest delivery, gives the correct data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
